rag.text:
Test: TC-272 — Feature area - Task Dependencies -   Creating external dependencies in Gantt module
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-54 Feature area - Task Dependency
Labels: ppm-e2e-cloud, teamspace

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-272 PI Project A
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed
2. Click on key of taskName to open Jira issue view
   Data: taskName: TC-272 Task A1
   Expected: Jira issue detail view for "TC-272 Task A1" is displayed
3. Click on More -> Link and create dependency passing this set of data
   Data: dependencyType (this issue): has to be done before
targetIssueKey: TC272B-1
   Expected: Link is created and displayed in Issue Links section on Jira issue view
4. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-272 PI Project A
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed.

A lozenge with number 1, symbolizing an external dependency, appears to the right of the task "TC-272 Task A1"
5. Hover over the lozenge next to taskName
   Data: taskName: TC-272 Task A1
   Expected: Tooltip is displayed with information about 1 External link
6. Open Dependencies dropdown menu and select Collapsed option
   Expected: External dependency lozenges disappear.

Bubble with number 1 is displayed next to "TC-272 Task A1"
7. Click on the bubble next to taskName and hover over the icon on the outgoing dependecy
   Data: taskName: TC-272 Task A1
   Expected: Inline dialog is displayed with folLowing information:
Task dependencies 
OUTGOING DEPENDENCIES 
TC-272 Task A2.

Tooltip is displayed "Out of view (it is not possible to see this task because it belongs to another Box)"
8. Click on three dots next task taskName
   Data: taskName: TC-272 Task A2
   Expected: Only Delete option is displayed.
9. Open Infobar - Dependencies tab hover over the icon right next to the taskName and taskName1 dependency
   Data: taskName: TC-272 Task A1
taskName1:TC-272 Task A2
   Expected: Tooltip is displayed: "Dependency is not visible on the timeline due to the target task is out of view"
10. Navigate to Box configuration -> Tasks -> Scope definition tab of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-272 PI Project A
   Expected: Scope definition tab is displayed
11. Expand Automatic rules section and add projectName to Project section

Save changes
   Data: projectName: TC-272 Gantt - Creating external dependencies - Project B
   Expected: Settings are saved.
12. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-272 PI Project A
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed.

Bubbles with numbers 1 is displayed next to "TC-272 Task A1"  and "TC-272 Task A2"
13. Open Dependencies dropdown menu and select Expanded option
   Expected: External dependency lozenges are no longer displayed.

Tasks "TC-272 Task A1" and "TC-272 Task A2" are linked with strong dependency.
